recipes.oracle_text:
Creatures you control get +2/+0 until end of turn.
Flashback {2}{R} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)

recipe_coverage: Reviewed board-wide temporary stat component: exact signed power/toughness, friendly/opposing/color/subtype scope, unchanged noncreatures, reduced-toughness deaths including indestructible witnesses, stacking and cleanup, later arrivals, preexisting damage, ordered populated libraries and owned hands/graveyards/exile, normal printed mana cost, caller-owned snapshot replay after AI. Includes untapping/draw/scry/death-life/exile clauses when declared. Other Oracle clauses (keyword grants and combat, kicker, alternate costs, cycling, flashback, madness, awaken, spell mastery, vehicles) remain separate coverage gaps where present. No complete-card coverage claim.
